scope: Initial confirmed correction scope; domain requirements and explicit gaps remain in inventory.json and README.md

requirements.statement: Checked TLA+ translation must be reproducible byte-for-byte from its PlusCal source using the pinned translator before model results are admitted.
requirements.interpretation: Current audit sections 4, 6 and 8 require source correspondence and reproducibility; PC-01 through PC-06 refine the tooling contract.
requirements.verification: Real-translator integrity and mutation regressions; no translator correctness proof
requirements.evidence: formal CI result/models.log and source manifest

requirements.statement: A failed, incomplete or source-stale formal execution must never be admitted as passing evidence; relevant changes must trigger fresh checks.
requirements.property: admit iff successful exit, no signal/error, completed suite, unchanged source digest
requirements.verification: Exhaustive finite truth-table check of actual admission function; source/tool hash and execution logs. No log authenticity or hostile-runner proof.
requirements.evidence: formal CI source/result manifests and regression output

requirements.statement: Admitted capture increments must be positive, preserve exact cumulative minor units and not exceed the authorized ceiling.
requirements.source: docs/payments/ecuador-payment-platform-audit-2026-09-09.md#state-model (accepted ADR-0200; cumulative capture bounds); docs/adr/0102-versioned-money-and-holds.md (integer minor units)
requirements.property: accepted => result = exact(current + increment) and current < result <= ceiling
requirements.verification: Source-derived signed-64-bit SMT safety/admission equivalence, SAT witnesses and negative controls; actual Haskell boundary oracle. Caller preconditions manually inspected; SQL/whole-program proof open.

requirements.statement: Admitted refund increments must be positive, preserve exact cumulative minor units and not exceed captured funds.
requirements.source: docs/payments/ecuador-payment-platform-audit-2026-09-09.md#invariants (accepted ADR-0200 invariant 6; partial totals cannot exceed captured funds)
requirements.property: accepted iff increment > 0 and exact(current + increment) <= captured; accepted update preserves exact sum
requirements.verification: Same full-width source-derived SMT and actual-module oracle boundary as SYS-MONEY-001; provider execution and authorization excluded

requirements.statement: Ledger balance validation must compare exact per-currency sums, not modular Int64 sums.
requirements.property: per-currency accumulated sum uses arbitrary precision
requirements.verification: Integer type and inspected conversion before accumulation; 512 actual-module boundary sequences and Hspec regressions. No proof of persisted SQL ledger or production use of this helper.
